name: 2 Timothy
author: The apostle Paul.
setting: Paul writes from prison, expecting to die.
theme: Be faithful, guard the gospel, and pass it on.

outline.label: Fan into flame the gift of God
Do not be ashamed of the testimony
All Scripture is breathed out by God
I have fought the good fight

christInBook: Paul says that Christ Jesus abolished death and brought life and immortality to light through the gospel (1:10), and that the Lord stood by him and strengthened him (4:17).
howToRead: 2 Timothy is Paul’s last letter, written near the end of his life. Notice the urgency: guard the gospel, endure suffering, and pass it on.
